attributes.name: footer density
attributes.definition: How much content and visual weight the footer carries overall.

values.definition: Slim footer with very little content, few links, no dense legal text.
Some link groups or extra elements, but not heavy.
Large footer with many links, legal text or sections.

attributes.name: footer social and payment icons
attributes.definition: Whether the footer shows social media or payment icon graphics.

values.definition: No social or payment icon graphics; plain text or links only.
Footer shows both social and payment icons.

attributes.name: footer link presentation
attributes.definition: How footer links and text are rendered.

values.definition: Links or text rendered as simple unstyled text.
Links styled as buttons, badges or icons.

attributes.name: footer structure
attributes.definition: Structural elements used inside the footer.

values.definition: Footer consists of one link only.
Two text columns with a horizontal rule above the copyright.
Back-to-top link and a list of plain links.
